newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in directionless after-hours trade on Tuesday, after edging up during the day, backed by firmer Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and a weaker yen, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 0.5 yen up than the day's close. Benchmark May was 0.1 yen up at 144.0 yen.

Volume was 3,383 lots. "Most private investors retreated to the sidelines in directionless trade. We expect the benchmark May contract to be confined within ranges between 140 yen and 145 yen per kg for the rest of this year," one trader said.
